title: Public Safety & Strategic Planning Insights
summary:
*   City leaders engaged in a strategic planning work session, discussing approaches for enhancing public safety and fostering positive community relations.
*   An executive session was held to address confidential matters, including potential land acquisitions, ongoing litigation, and appointments to various city boards.
*   This special meeting focused primarily on internal discussions and planning, without any public hearings or immediate policy votes.
